facts.text: Markham is home to over 650 corporate head offices and more than 1,500 high tech and life science companies.
More than 1,000 technology and life sciences companies in Markham employ 37,000 people, over one-fifth of the city's total workforce of 167,500.
Global companies headquartered in Markham include AMD, IBM, Honda, Aviva, Oracle, Nokia, TD Bank, General Motors, Stantec, GE and AECOM.
Markham is a leader in attracting foreign direct investment, with more than 234 foreign companies located in the city.

overview: Markham counted 338,503 residents in the 2021 Census, up 2.9 percent from 328,966 in 2016, living in 110,867 occupied private dwellings on 210.93 square kilometres. Growth is slow, so a local business competes mainly for existing households rather than newcomers.

Those households are affluent and mature, with a median age of 42.4 and a median household income of $104,000 in 2020. Markham's economy is anchored by corporate head offices and technology firms, which means both consumer and business customers expect a polished, professional presence and are willing to pay for quality once they trust a provider.
